Three NEEDS-ATTENDED-FETCH sources (Verisk 10-K for CargoNet, WTW Marketplace Realities 2025, Statista Japan) remain unverified. The High-confidence claims are solid — IUMI primary-association and McKinsey primary-consultancy authored reports anchor the macro market-size and structural insurance market framing reliably. The corpus should ship with mandatory deep-research on the top 3 weak claim clusters before the WH4/WH5 hypothesis assessments are presented as fully evidenced.
